name: LootboxPoolEntry - Join Entry (seed v1)
description: An adjustment of one lootbox type's item pool: add an item from elsewhere, change an item's weight, or leave one out. Created from the type's Item pool step (Create New Join Entry).

steps.description: The pool starts as every graded item of the type's category that isn't a lootbox special. Each entry changes one item.

fields.label: Item
fields.description: The item to add, re-weight or leave out. Each item can have one entry per type.

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Include adds the item (from any category) or keeps it with the weight and grade below; Exclude removes an item the category would otherwise give.

fields.label: Weight
fields.description: Relative weight (0 or more) among the pool items of the same grade. Empty = 1. Ignored for Exclude.

fields.label: Drop grade
fields.description: The grade the item drops as. Needed to include an item without a grade of its own; otherwise empty keeps the item's grade. Ignored for Exclude.
